<thought>We need a real template ID that can retrosynthetically convert the alkene product COc1ccc(cc1)C=C(Cc2ccc(OC)cc2) back to the ketone COc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)C(Cc2ccc(OC)cc2) and the trimethylsilyl reagent C[Si](C)(C)C. We'll search the template catalog for templates that break a C‑C double bond and form a ketone. This should return at least one applicable template. Then we can use that template ID in the final route JSON.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccc(cc1)C=C(Cc2ccc(OC)cc2)",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"]
}</action_input>
